title: Sci-Fi
story: Blast off into the stars, where saucers glide, rockets roar and the lab lights glow.
declined: moon flag: replaced, could read as national or political

cards.name: Flying Saucer
cards.subject: A round silver flying saucer with a smooth glass dome on top and a ring of round yellow lights around its rim, seen slightly from the side, flying in a clear sky.
